grammars.edited-cart:
root ::= "{" ws "\"size\"" ws ":" ws integer ws "," ws "\"last\"" ws ":" ws integer ws "}"
ws ::= " "?
integer ::= "-"? ("0" | [1-9] [0-9]*)
grammars.pressed-contact:
root ::= "{" ws "\"level\"" ws ":" ws ("\"high\"" | "\"low\"") ws "," ws "\"pressed\"" ws ":" ws ("true" | "false") ws "}"
ws ::= " "?
integer ::= "-"? ("0" | [1-9] [0-9]*)
grammars.missed-labels:
root ::= "{" ws "\"tp\"" ws ":" ws integer ws "," ws "\"fn\"" ws ":" ws integer ws "}"
ws ::= " "?
integer ::= "-"? ("0" | [1-9] [0-9]*)
grammars.reversed-route:
root ::= "[" ws (integer (ws "," ws integer)*)? ws "]"
ws ::= " "?
integer ::= "-"? ("0" | [1-9] [0-9]*)
